claims.summary: Over F2, independent A:m by n,B:n by m,m>n>=1,E=AB,Fij=deltaij+Eij,P=prod(1+Fij), full original Boolean placeholders Z. Let tau exchange Ail with Bli, corresponding Boolean placeholders and Yij with Yji. No formally tau-invariant linear Boolean Q with Q(X,0)=0,Q(X,b)=P exists: on B=A^T with paired Z identified all coefficient pairs cancel, whereas P restricts further to [prod_i t_i prod_i<j(1+t_it_j)]²!=0. No formally tau-invariant Hilbert-like full certificate for exact tuple(F,b) exists either: at the fixed Boolean point all A rows/B columns=e1, fields and diagonal F vanish, off-diagonal F=1, so paired coefficient contributions cancel. These exclude added symmetry/linearity regardless of circuit size, not asymmetric or nonlinear certificates or arbitrary augmented tuples.

claims.summary: Over F2, a finite group G compatibly permuting old variables and complete generators/placeholders and a supplied general IPS certificate C give invariant general IPS N=1+prod_g(1+gC), with no oddness hypothesis. Size O(|G|(S+1)), depth<=d+3, total degree<=|G|D and placeholder degree<=|G|r for input bounds S,d,D,r. For an involution tau, N=C+tauC+C*tauC has size O(S+1), depth<=d+2 and doubled degree ceilings. Hilbert-like input gives placeholder degree<=2, not preserved linearity. It copies supplied certificates and does not create unavailable small ones, supply PC degree bounds or make a growing group orbit free. For a full binary rank correction Q(X,b)=P, the direct invariant certificate 1+[prod_ij(1+Yij)]²+Q*tauQ has full identities. With joint minor circuits H,e from the tail formula it costs O(H+m⁴+m²n+1), depth<=e+10, total output degree<=4m²-2, Boolean-placeholder degree<=2 and input-placeholder degree<=2m²; the minor cost remains unpaid.
